one_liner: AI Agent + Helpdesk built as one, featuring conversation management, automation, and third-party integrations.
auth_notes: Header-based API key (e.g. Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>) and OAuth2 are supported for connecting external apps.
verdict_reason: Gorgias supports public API/HTTP integrations and webhooks with header-based or OAuth2 authentication, though full developer API portal details are sparse in the provided text.

evidence.quote: If you're looking to connect to a platform that doesn't have an existing app in our App Store, you can build an HTTP integration using the third-party's public API.

If your API requires authentication, you have two options: Header-based: Add the necessary key-value pairs under Header — for example, Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>.OAuth2: Toggle on Enable authentication method: OAuth2

Under Triggers, select the ticket events that should fire this integration. The available triggers are Ticket created, Ticket updated, Ticket self unsnoozed, Ticket message created, and Ticket message failed.
